title: Diosgenin alleviates hepatic fibrosis via PI3K/Akt/mTOR mediated fatty acid metabolic reprogramming and NF-kappaB activation.
authors: Shi, Yuanrong; Zhang, Ye; Liu, Dan; Xiang, Shuang; Liang, Shufang; Lin, Wanfu; Li, Shu; Zhai, Xiaofeng; Cheng, Binbin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究薯蓣皂苷元通过PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路缓解肝纤维化，属于药物机制与代谢研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Dioscorea oppositifolia L., also called Shan Yao in traditional Chinese medicine, is widely used to treat diabetes, hyperthyroidism, and liver damage. Diosgenin (DIO), a natural steroidal sapogenin, found abundantly in Dioscorea oppositifolia L., has historically been used to treat liver disorders. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the effect of DIO against hepatic fibrosis and the underlying molecular mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We utilized a CCl4-induced mouse model of hepatic fibrosis and TGF-beta1-stimulated LX-2 human hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) to determine the anti-fibrotic effect of DIO. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and Western blotting were employed to identify the targets and elucidate mechanisms. RESULTS: In vivo, DIO markedly improved CCl4-induced liver damage, collagen deposition and alpha-SMA expression, while reducing serum levels of ALT, AST, ALP, and hydroxyproline. In vitro, DIO suppressed TGF-beta1-induced proliferation, activation, and fibrogenic gene expression in LX2 cells. Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified mTOR and PIK3CA as direct binding targets of DIO, which was further validated by cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). Consistently, DIO blocked the PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling cascade in activated HSCs, subsequently inhibiting NF-kappaB activation and attenuating IL6 and IL8 production. Notably, DIO counteracted TGF-beta1-induced fatty acid uptake and de novo lipogenesis (DNL), as evidenced by BODIPY 500/510 C1, C12 and Nile red staining. This regulatory effect of DIO on metabolic reprogramming was attributed to the downregulation of CD36, SREBP1, FASN, SCD1, and CPT1A. Additionally, DIO reduced intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation in TGF-beta1-activated HSCs. The anti-fibrotic and fatty acid metabolism-regulating effects of DIO were abrogated by the mTOR agonist MHY1485. CONCLUSION: DIO alleviates hepatic fibrosis by suppressing HSCs activation and modulating fatty acid metabolism through inhibiting the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway. Our results suggest that DIO is a promising natural candidate for the treatment of hepatic fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：薯蓣（Dioscorea oppositifolia L.），在传统中医中亦称山药，广泛用于治疗糖尿病、甲状腺功能亢进和肝损伤。薯蓣皂苷元（DIO），一种天然甾体皂苷元，在薯蓣中含量丰富，历史上曾用于治疗肝脏疾病。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨DIO对肝纤维化的影响及其潜在分子机制。材料与方法：我们利用CCl4诱导的小鼠肝纤维化模型和TGF-β1刺激的LX-2人肝星状细胞（HSCs）来评估DIO的抗纤维化作用。采用网络药理学、分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和Western blotting来识别靶点并阐明机制。结果：在体内，DIO显著改善了CCl4诱导的肝损伤、胶原沉积和α-SMA表达，同时降低了血清中ALT、AST、ALP和羟脯氨酸水平。在体外，DIO抑制了TGF-β1诱导的LX2细胞增殖、活化和纤维化基因表达。网络药理学和分子对接确定mTOR和PIK3CA为DIO的直接结合靶点，并通过细胞热位移分析（CETSA）进一步验证。一致地，DIO阻断活化HSCs中的PI3K/Akt/mTOR信号级联，随后抑制NF-κB激活并减弱IL6和IL8的产生。值得注意的是，DIO抵消了TGF-β1诱导的脂肪酸摄取和从头脂肪生成（DNL），如BODIPY 500/510 C1、C12和尼罗红染色所示。DIO对代谢重编程的这种调节作用归因于CD36、SREBP1、FASN、SCD1和CPT1A的下调。此外，DIO减少了TGF-β1活化HSCs中细胞内活性氧（ROS）的积累。DIO的抗纤维化和脂肪酸代谢调节作用被mTOR激动剂MHY1485所消除。结论：DIO通过抑制PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路，抑制HSCs活化并调节脂肪酸代谢，从而缓解肝纤维化。我们的结果表明，DIO是治疗肝纤维化的有前景的天然候选药物。
